items.title: Add focused dev-memory legacy-read verification
items.context: Add a narrow smoke test proving .lattice entries are preferred/written, .koala entries are read-only fallback, duplicate ids are deduped, and dev-memory remains non-authoritative/non-gate evidence.
items.userSees: User sees the focused dev-memory legacy-read smoke pass, proving read fallback, dedupe, .lattice writes, and non-authoritative entries.

happy.desc: Focused smoke test proves .lattice and legacy .koala project/global memory entries are both readable.

edge.desc: Focused smoke test proves duplicate ids across .lattice and .koala inputs are deduped deterministically.

adversarial.desc: Focused smoke test proves capture/write behavior still writes to .lattice and entries remain gateEvidence=false and authority=non_authoritative.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke passed and covers reading both current .lattice and legacy .koala project/global dev-memory entries.
The smoke asserts duplicate ids across .lattice and .koala are deduped with the current .lattice entry winning.
The smoke asserts capture writes .lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, does not write .koala/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, and all entries remain gateEvidence=false and authority=non_authoritative.
